title: A Wedding at Linden Avenue Manor
victim: Artemy Volynsky, father of the bride
teaser: The guests had just raised their glasses when the bride's father went to his study for a letter he wanted to read out in his toast. The letter disappeared, and the father never came out of the study again. Now the whole wedding party sits in the ballroom, eyeing one another.
locations: The study of the bride's father
scene: The study of the bride's father

habits.label: Sealing wax on the fingers
habits.habit: Fingers flecked with red sealing wax
clues: The seal on the envelope from the desk drawer is broken, crumbs of red sealing wax are scattered over the green baize, and there's a red smear on the door handle. The culprit has sealing wax on their fingers.
In the library, a page of an open book carries a red fingerprint with a crumb of sealing wax. The culprit has red sealing wax on their fingers.

habits.label: White carnation
clues: Two white carnation petals lie on the study rug, though there are only peonies in the house today. The culprit wears a white carnation buttonhole.
A crushed white carnation on a pin was found under the study window, on the linden avenue. The culprit wears a white carnation buttonhole.

habits.label: Pocket watch on a chain
habits.habit: A silver watch on a chain
clues: A broken silver link from a watch chain is stuck in the crack of a desk drawer. The culprit wears a watch on a chain.
At 23:05 someone heard the sharp click of a pocket watch lid behind the study door, and the victim wore a wristwatch. The culprit carries a watch on a chain.

habits.label: Dances the tango
clues: A dance card lies on the study floor: a tango is pencilled in for 23:00, and the partner's name has been torn off. The culprit dances the tango.
The musicians say the tango was requested in advance for eleven o'clock, and that's exactly when one couple left the floor. The culprit dances the tango.

habits.label: Plays the piano
clues: The old piano in the library is open, with fresh fingermarks on the dusty keys and no music on the stand. The culprit plays the piano by ear.
At 23:05 half a waltz was heard from the library, played confidently and broken off in the middle. The culprit plays the piano.

habits.label: Scar on the chin
habits.habit: A white scar across the chin
clues: At 23:15 someone in the carriage house noticed a person with a white scar across the chin at the study window. The culprit has a scar on their chin.
A photographic plate taken at 23:00 by the gazebo shows a guest in the corner of the frame with a white scar on the chin. The culprit has a scar on their chin.

habits.label: Drinks cognac
clues: There are two glasses on the study desk: one holds the victim's champagne, the other the dregs of Armenian cognac. The culprit drinks cognac.
The guests have been served nothing but champagne all evening, yet the cognac decanter from the sideboard is empty and standing in the study. The culprit prefers cognac.

habits.label: Knows Blok by heart
clues: On the study blotter the line "Night, street, lamp, chemist's" shows through in someone else's hand. The culprit knows Blok by heart.
Instead of the letter, the envelope holds a sheet with a stanza of Blok written from memory without a single mistake. The culprit knows Blok's poems by heart.

habits.label: Plays chess
clues: In the afternoon the chess table in the library held a drawn position, and now Black has been set up for mate in three. The culprit plays chess.
There's a note in someone else's handwriting in the victim's pocket: "Qf7, mate". The culprit plays chess.

habits.label: Monogrammed handkerchief
habits.habit: A cambric handkerchief with a monogram
clues: A cambric handkerchief with an embroidered monogram was found by the study fireplace; it was used to wipe the dust off the drawer handle. The culprit carries a monogrammed handkerchief.
A monogrammed handkerchief lies under the bench in the gazebo, linden leaves and black paper ash in its folds. The culprit carries an embroidered handkerchief.

habits.label: Tarred boots
clues: There are black heel-shaped tar stains on the Persian rug in the study. The culprit's boots are greased with tar.
A trail that smells of tar runs through the grass from the carriage house to the study window. The culprit wears tar-greased boots.

habits.label: Brilliantine
clues: The high back of the study armchair has a greasy stain that smells of brilliantine, and the victim never used it. The culprit wears brilliantine.
There's a shiny greasy mark smelling of brilliantine on the library door frame, at head height. The culprit slicks their hair with brilliantine.

habits.label: Signet ring
habits.habit: A gold signet ring on the little finger
clues: A pattern with a bird is pressed into the wax of a candle in the study, the kind a signet ring leaves. The culprit wears a signet ring.
The varnish on the study door is scratched at hand height, and gold dust glints in the scratch. The culprit wears a gold ring on their little finger.

habits.label: Sneezes at peonies
habits.habit: Sneezes at the smell of peonies
clues: The vase of peonies has been carried out of the study into the corridor, though it stood on the desk this morning. The culprit can't stand peonies and sneezes at them.
At 23:05 someone in the corridor heard rapid sneezing behind the study door. The culprit sneezes at the smell of peonies.

habits.label: Gold tooth
habits.habit: A gold crown on a front tooth
clues: From the gazebo someone saw a gold crown flash in a smile in the lamplight at the study window. The culprit has a gold tooth.
A bitten pear in the bowl on the study desk has a deep groove in the flesh from a metal crown. The culprit has a gold tooth.

habits.label: Anchor tattoo
habits.habit: A blue anchor tattooed on the wrist
clues: From the kitchen, someone saw a hand with a blue anchor on the wrist drawing the study curtain. The culprit has an anchor tattooed on their wrist.
At dinner the victim joked about a guest with a navy anchor on their wrist and promised to tell the story in his toast. The culprit has an anchor on their wrist.

keys: The study was locked, its key hangs on the servants' shared ring, and the lock was opened without a scratch. The culprit had keys.
The desk drawer with the letter was opened with its own small key, which guests are never given. The culprit had keys.
passages: A narrow servants' staircase leads from the study down to the kitchen, and there's a fresh footprint on its steps. The culprit knows the service passages.
Nobody walked past the ballroom to the study, but you can get there from the library through the linen room. The culprit knows the service passages.
strong: A heavy oak armchair was pushed against the study door so it couldn't be opened from outside. The culprit is physically strong.
The victim was moved from the window to the fireplace, and Volynsky weighed over a hundred kilos. The culprit is physically strong.
perfume: The study curtain smells of a thick perfume with a note of iris. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
A sweet smell of heavy perfume lingers on the empty envelope. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
french: A sheet by the inkwell has a postscript in French: "Il ne lira jamais". The culprit knows French.
At about 23:00 a short argument in French was heard from the study. The culprit knows French.
tools: The window catch in the study was removed with a screwdriver, the screws laid neatly on the sill. The culprit is handy with tools.
The drawer lock was forced with a thin chisel from the carriage house so neatly that the gap is barely visible. The culprit is handy with tools.
whistle: Someone on the linden avenue below the study windows was heard whistling the wedding march. The culprit whistles.
The kitchen staff remember someone whistling an old drinking song in the corridor at about 23:05. The culprit whistles.
quiet: The creaky parquet outside the study stayed silent all evening, though the door was opened twice. The culprit moves silently.
The dogs in the servants' quarters didn't bark, though the way in from the garden runs right past them. The culprit moves silently.
safe: The wall safe behind the portrait was opened without a single scratch, and the letter isn't in it. The culprit knows the safe combination.
Volynsky changed the safe combination the day before the wedding, and the safe is open all the same. The culprit knows the safe combination.
cash: Some of the gold coins are missing from the dowry envelope, and the receipt for them is forged. The culprit had access to money.
The money for the band and the cook has vanished from the box in the study, and the expense book balances perfectly. The culprit had access to money.
driver: The groom's motor car isn't where it stood in the afternoon, and its engine is still warm. The culprit can drive.
A fresh tyre track runs from the carriage house to the end of the linden avenue and back. The culprit can drive.
medic: The victim's glass has a bitter residue, and the dose was judged exactly for a heavy man. The culprit knows about poisons.
A bottle of heart drops is missing from the household medicine chest; it stands empty by the decanter in the study. The culprit knows about poisons.
tech: The electricity in the study wing went out at exactly 23:05, and the fuses were unscrewed by someone who knew what they were doing. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The telephone in the study wasn't ripped out but neatly disconnected from the set. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
cane: There are round dents from the tip of a walking stick on the study rug. The culprit walks with a cane.
At about 23:05 the steady tap of a cane was heard in the corridor by the library. The culprit walks with a cane.
